interactiveVocabulary.definition: the act of traveling through a place to learn about it.
examples: We studied plants during our exploration of the forest.

interactiveVocabulary.definition: having a lot of meaning or value; necessary.
examples: It is important to get a good night's sleep.

interactiveVocabulary.definition: tools or devices with moving parts that help people do work.
examples: Machines make it easier to cook in our kitchen.
Hitting balls helps Ben prepare for his baseball game.

interactiveVocabulary.definition: to fix something that is broken or damaged.
examples: The plumber will repair the broken sink.

interactiveVocabulary.definition: something that happens because of something else.
examples: The tree fell over as a result of the storm.

interactiveVocabulary.definition: relating to science or using the methods of science.
examples: Our scientific study helped us learn about rocks.

interactiveVocabulary.definition: when a group of people work together to achieve a goal.
examples: It takes teamwork to win a baseball game.
